summary: Shows human_to_bytes converting strings like '10.00 KB' or '1.1 GB' to byte counts, with isbits for bit units.
questions: How do I convert '10 MB' to bytes in Ansible?

answer_card.title: human_to_bytes
answer_card.answer_md:
```jinja
{{ '10.00 KB' | human_to_bytes }}   # 10240
{{ '11 MB' | human_to_bytes }}      # 11534336
{{ '1.1 GB' | human_to_bytes }}     # 1181116006
{{ '10.00 Kb' | human_to_bytes(isbits=True) }}   # 10240
```
